_scope: F26 performance, CPU only, local presentation. How often far-away presentation refreshes; no save, network, combat or gameplay state. enabled false restores every-frame refresh everywhere.

crop_plot._comment: A homestead crop bed farther than far_m from the camera re-reads its plot, seeds and prompt label every refresh_s instead of every frame. Its prompt radius is 2 m; growth still shows within refresh_s. Open, queued or claimed beds always refresh.

mote_vfx._comment: Alpha auras and aspect VFX rebuild their camera-facing ImmediateMesh every tick only within far_m of the camera; beyond it every rebuild_ticks ticks; hidden, never.
